## Combining datasets using set statement

-   List two or more datasets
    -   Stacks one beneath the other
    -   Variable names should match
    
::: {.notes}

:::
    
## Combining datasets using merge statement   

- List two or more datasets
    -   Stacks side-by-side
    -   Beware of misalignment
    
::: {.notes}

:::
    
## Using the by statement

-   `by` key
-   key controls the match

::: {.notes}
